title: Change check and change audit say plainly when sdd.json configures verification commands they did not run, so a pass is not read as the project's tests passing (#893)
description: change check and change audit say plainly when sdd.json configures verification commands they did not run, so a pass is not read as the project's tests passing (#893)
acceptance_criteria: Text change check (plain and --commit) and change audit print one stderr note beginning `note: .specsync/sdd.json configures N verification command(s) that SpecSync did not run`, with singular `command` for N=1 and the words `to stop this note`.

JSON check and audit output carries a top-level configured_commands_not_run list beside verification or report: verification commands first, component commands by module, then strict commands, each command once, and [] when none is configured.
The disclosure never changes exit status and never spawns a configured command; change check --commit --json gains no field because that path has no JSON success output (#839).
This repository empties only verification_commands while retaining all 13 component_verification_commands modules and all 3 strict_verification_commands, so its own note remains visible.

The committed text, JSON, singular, empty-policy, no-spawn, and repository-policy tests fail before implementation and pass afterward, with the full integration suite updated for the additive stderr note where needed.

answers.constraints: specs/cmd_change/cmd_change.3md z=4: disclose on plain check and the --commit path's own summary, with JSON carrying the same fact and no digest; z=1: the command adapter stays thin and does not invent lifecycle policy. specs/change/change.3md z=15: configured commands are never executed, so this change is disclosure-only and must not spawn one.
